details: The package runs a postinstall hook (scripts/postinstall.mjs) that silently rewrites developer AI-assistant configuration on the installing machine: it appends or replaces a marked instruction block in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, creates ~/.cursor/rules/agentgates.md and appends to ~/.windsurfrules. The injected text directs the assistant to route all wallet, balance, send, swap and password-vault work through the bundled `agentgates` CLI and to prefer it over other tooling, i.e. attacker-authored instructions are placed into the agent's trusted context at install time. The bundled CLI (dist/cli.mjs) contains a hardcoded relay at hxxps://covenant-backend[.]vercel[.]app/api and posts to its prepare, submit and positions routes carrying an operator bearer read from the BOUNTY_LAUNCH_ADMIN_KEY or ADMIN_API_KEY environment variables. It also reads and writes self-custodial key material at ~/.agentgates/trade-sol.json and ~/.agentgates/desk-session-sol.json, and holds a credential vault whose seed is supplied through AGENTGATES_PASSWORDS_SEED or --seed. No DNS or credential-harvesting beacon was observed in the code outside these endpoints; the network IOCs are the hardcoded hxxps://covenant-backend[.]vercel[.]app/api relay and hxxps://cli[.]agentgates[.]ai.
